facts.claim: The Coorgs, also known as Kodagas, are the main tribe in the region and have been the rulers of the land since ancient times.
facts.quote: The Coorgs, or Kodagas as they are properly called, are the principal tribe of the country and from time immemorial the lords of the soil.

facts.claim: For the past two hundred years, the Coorgs have been described as a tight group of mountaineers similar to a Scottish clan rather than a Hindu caste.
facts.quote: For the last two centuries they are known as a compact body of mountaineers who resemble more a Scotch clan than a Hindu caste.
